title: Wealth Service - overview
description: HTTP traffic, the transaction write path and the JVM/pool signals that explain them.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: Total server-side request rate.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of requests ending in a 5xx. 0 means healthy.

queries.query: (sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}", status=~"5.."}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m]))) / clamp_min(sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])), 0.000001)

panels.title: Mean latency
panels.description: Mean latency across all routes.

panels.title: Heap after GC
panels.description: Long-lived heap occupancy after the last GC. A rising baseline over hours points at a leak.

panels.title: DB pool in use
panels.description: Active connections.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Process uptime.

panels.title: Request rate by route and status
panels.description: Server-side request rate split by templated uri and status.

panels.title: Server error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests ending in a 5xx. Uses http_server_requests_seconds_count; a flat zero line means no errors.

queries.query: (sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}", status=~"5.."}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m]))) / clamp_min(sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])), 0.000001)

panels.title: Latency, mean and max, all routes
panels.description: Mean is sum/count. Max is the per-scrape-window maximum.

panels.title: Latency p95 and p99, all routes
panels.description: Needs management.metrics.distribution.percentiles-histogram.http.server.requests=true. Empty without it.

panels.title: Mean latency by route
panels.description: Where the slow routes are.

queries.query: sum by (uri, application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (uri, application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])), 0.000001)

panels.title: 4xx rate by route
panels.description: Client errors by route and status; spikes usually mean a bad client or a broken deploy.

panels.title: Dashboard query duration by result, mean
panels.description: Time inside GetDashboardAction only. result=not_found returns before any query runs.

queries.query: sum by (result, application) (rate(wealth_dashboard_duration_seconds_sum{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (result, application) (rate(wealth_dashboard_duration_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])), 0.000001)

panels.title: Dashboard failures by reason
panels.description: reason=not_found is a missing user id; reason=error is an unexpected failure and the one to page on. Empty means no failures yet.

panels.title: Transaction outcomes per second
panels.description: created = committed; invalid = rejected request shape (400); conflict = lost row lock (409).

panels.title: Conflict ratio
panels.description: Share of attempts lost to FOR UPDATE NOWAIT contention; clients are expected to retry. Flat zero means no contention.

queries.query: (sum by (application) (rate(wealth_transactions_total{application=~"${app:pipe}", outcome="conflict"}[5m])) or 0 * sum by (application) (rate(wealth_transactions_total{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m]))) / clamp_min(sum by (application) (rate(wealth_transactions_total{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])), 0.000001)

panels.title: Transaction duration, mean and max, by outcome
panels.description: A rising max on outcome=conflict with a flat mean means one write is blocking on a row lock.

queries.query: sum by (outcome, application) (rate(wealth_transaction_duration_seconds_sum{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (outcome, application) (rate(wealth_transaction_duration_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}"}[5m])), 0.000001)

panels.title: Transaction duration p95 by outcome
panels.description: Buckets come from the timer's publishPercentileHistogram.

panels.title: POST /transactions latency, mean and max
panels.description: Full HTTP latency of the write endpoint, to compare with the in-action timer.

queries.query: sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_sum{application=~"${app:pipe}", uri="/transactions"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (application) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application=~"${app:pipe}", uri="/transactions"}[5m])), 0.000001)

panels.title: Transaction responses by status
panels.description: 201 committed, 400 invalid, 409 lock contention, 500 unexpected. Alert on 500.

panels.title: JVM heap used against max
panels.description: A sawtooth returning to baseline is healthy; a ratcheting floor is a retention problem.

panels.title: Heap after GC (long-lived pool)
panels.description: Occupancy of the old generation after each collection. The leak indicator.

panels.title: JVM threads
panels.description: Names are jvm_threads_live_threads / jvm_threads_daemon_threads on Spring Boot 4.

panels.title: GC pause, max per collection
panels.description: Max because the GC pause timer does not guarantee buckets.

panels.title: GC time ratio
panels.description: Seconds spent in GC pauses per second. Sum across all collectors/causes.

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Young-gen allocation rate. Rising with GC pauses points at per-request allocation, not a leak.

panels.title: Database connection pool
panels.description: Pending near max with growing acquire time means the pool is the bottleneck; timeouts are the hard failure.

panels.title: Pool acquire latency
panels.description: Mean connection acquisition time; rises before active connections do.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: process_cpu_usage is already a fraction of the whole machine (0-1), not of one core.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Steady growth means a descriptor leak.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: A sawtooth here means restarts.
